d:
Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a smooth texture. Sharp, almond-shaped golden yellow eyes. Appears as a mature adult with a calm, disciplined expression. Slender, athletic build wearing a traditional white and crimson red miko-style outfit with wide sleeves and a red hakama. Features a signature large red folding fan and a small red ribbon tied to the hair.
BODY COLOR: white and crimson
